justification: Pure-Python ssdeep (no C extension, no wheel needed) for file_hashing (P267 FC2): ssdeep is computed only for regular files <= 50 MB when ppdeep is installed; MD5/SHA-1/SHA-256/SHA-512 never depend on it, so the module stays available without it.
notes: Optional extra of batch p1-G07-2. TLSH is not computed locally in this build (py-tlsh ships no wheels, P267 FC2); provider TLSH values are kept as attributes.
